title: Oven Steamed Chinese Vegetable Tagine
description: A peppery and dense Chinese dish featuring salted butter and steam, made in a tagine pot, this recipe is a quick fix for a delicious meal. It is also shojin friendly.

ingredients.name: salted butter
ingredients.notes: unsalted butter can be used with added salt

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In the tagine pot, melt the salted butter over low heat.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped bok choy, sliced carrots, and chopped green onions, and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil, and pour over the vegetables.
Cover the tagine pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Steam the vegetables in the oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
